root_cause_hypothesis: Log export path may exhaust memory or hit a storage/permission fault on low-RAM Android 14 devices.

root_cause_hypothesis: Likely incoming-server authentication failure or IMAP folder subscription issue after an app update, leaving send working but fetch broken and Spam unsubscribed.

discovered_theme: Thunderbird for Android not offered as mailto: handler from Firefox
root_cause_hypothesis: Android has a previously set default app for mailto intents and Firefox's confirmation prompt bypasses the app chooser, so Thunderbird never appears.

discovered_theme: Unified inbox home-screen widget cannot sort unread mail first
root_cause_hypothesis: The Android widget uses a fixed date-based sort and does not read the app's message-sort preference.

discovered_theme: Cannot append extra CC recipients on Android because address field has no tappable empty space
root_cause_hypothesis: Recipient token chips fill the field width at larger system font sizes leaving no tappable area to focus the input, an accessibility/layout defect (workaround: tap the field label).

discovered_theme: Android account passwords randomly revert to old values, breaking sync
root_cause_hypothesis: Likely corruption or failed persistence of the app's credential database so stale stored passwords are reloaded after the in-memory session ends.

discovered_theme: Yahoo Spam folder missing/not syncing in Thunderbird for Android
root_cause_hypothesis: The Spam folder is not exposed/subscribed over IMAP by Yahoo or not mapped to Thunderbird's special folders.

discovered_theme: AOL account repeatedly prompts for login and stops receiving mail

discovered_theme: 'Mark as unread' button has no effect after update

discovered_theme: Cannot move message out of Trash on POP3 accounts (Android)

discovered_theme: Imported accounts on Android missing passwords, no sync after import
